title: Release track strata & compatibility playbook for runtime/API/SDK/Console
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Why: We need a concise, operational playbook that unifies how we define support horizons and compatibility guarantees across the serving runtime, public API, official SDKs, and Redwood Console. Current artifacts are fragmented and use inconsistent terminology (LTS / stability lane / channel) which leads to mistaken expectations during upgrades and cross-team rollouts. This ticket defines an opinionated strata model, compatibility contracts, and the tooling changes required to automate preflight checks and cohorted rollouts.
proposed_solution: Introduce a three-strata support model (Stabilize / Sustain / Sunset) with explicit compatibility contracts for binary/runtime artifacts, API surface, SDK semver promises, and Console UI migrations. Augment CI and deployment tooling with preflight validators, automated compatibility matrix exporters, and a cohort pinning service that enables safe canary cohorts and fast rollback. Provide a single compatibility CSV/JSON artifact per release that the Console and SDK installers can consume.
compatibility_contracts: Runtime: ABI/kv-cache binary compatibility for minor patch updates within a Stabilize stratum; breaking changes require new runtime channel and migration docs. API: Backwards-compatible endpoints guaranteed for Sustain window; deprecations follow a 3-phase announcement->grace->removal cadence. SDKs: Strict semver mapping to public API, with a compatibility table per language binding. Console: Feature flags tied to release channels; Console will support two active channels simultaneously with traffic steering.
support_horizon_buckets: Stabilize (recommended, 18 months): full bug fixes, security patches, performance backports, guaranteed API compatibility. Sustain (recommended, 12 months): critical fixes only, advisory deprecations allowed, SDKs get security and essential API fixes. Sunset (6 months): data/upgrade tooling only, customers encouraged to migrate; no new features and no SLA for latency. Each bucket has explicit timelines and migration expectations recorded in the release artifact.
rollout_gates: Pre-merge: unit/integration compatibility tests, API contract verification. Pre-release: cross-surface matrix validator (runtime+api+sdk+console) must pass, release notes drafted, deprecation notices scheduled. Post-release: cohort rollout to <5% traffic 24h, automated health checks and error budget monitoring for 72h, expand to 25% after 72h if SLOs met, then 100% after 7d. Abort conditions include >1% increase in 5xxs, token cost regression >10%, or customer-severity P0s related to regressions.
upgrade_tooling_changes: 1) Compatibility matrix exporter: job that outputs per-release CSV/JSON of supported runtime versions, API endpoints, SDK mappings. 2) Preflight validator CLI used in CI to confirm target cluster compatibility and schema diff checks. 3) Cohort pinning service with API to pin customers to a channel and unwind pins on rollback. 4) Rollback capacitor: automated short-circuit that pauses rollouts when abort conditions triggered and opens a rollback PR with suggested target version.
migration_plan: Phase 1: Publish the strata definitions and compatibility contract doc; update release checklist. Phase 2: Implement matrix exporter and preflight validator in CI; run a canary release for runtime-2.3 against sandbox tenants. Phase 3: Integrate cohort pinning with Console rollout UI and the API gateway. Phase 4: Execute a real customer upgrade using new tooling with postmortem and adjustments.
testing_plan: Unit tests for matrix exporter, e2e tests simulating mixed-version clusters, SDK conformance tests against published API contract, chaos tests for rollbacks, and staged acceptance tests that include Console feature flags. Add synthetic load jobs to the nightly pipeline to detect performance regressions under canary cohorts.
observability_and_alerting: New dashboards: compatibility-matrix-per-release, cohort-health (latency, error-rate, token-cost), canary-rollout-status. Alerts: canary-failure (>=1% 5xx delta), cost-regression (token-cost > 10% above baseline), sdk-contract-break (failing conformance tests). Each alert links to runbook and automatic incident template.
acceptance_criteria: Strata definitions published and acknowledged by Runtime, API, SDK, Console leads
Compatibility matrix exporter implemented and outputs machine-readable artifact per release
Preflight validator integrated into CI and fails polluted changes
Cohort pinning API exists and is usable from Console UI
Documentation and migration guide published in Confluence
Run one live canary upgrade using the new workflow and produce a postmortem
